lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “You crossed it twice. You forgot the sauce.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “It has more character than the intact ones.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Do you want to tell me which part?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “What did you have before you looked?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I can let you tell me when you know what it means.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Before too. If you tell me you're not sure.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I thought you could supply that part.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “What if you keep looking and the answer is that he didn't survive?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I'm not asking you to stop looking. I'm asking what happens to you while you do.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Then tell me there's a chance. You don't have to promise me you're certain.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “You can be glad to see someone and still have something to ask them.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I'm sitting here. You're the one who has to go.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Then don't say all of them to me instead.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “But if there's something he needs to hear, being polite here won't tell him.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “You were trying to apologise for being angry before you said anything.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “What do you want to do next?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “That sounds like something you can tell him.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Then I won’t guess it for you.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Should I be able to tell the difference?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “You haven't told me all of it.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “What happens if someone doesn't want you there?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I believe you. I don't know everyone who will speak for you.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “You wanted people to be able to tell you no. Don't make the first time they do it a test of whether they trust you.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Then keep listening when it's inconvenient. That's the part you can practise.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Is that what you think happened to your parents?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Knowing and feeling it aren't always the same.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “This one has had a difficult afternoon.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “You're standing in front of the food.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “A place to put it. That’s all.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Then I couldn't tell whether I remembered what it said or just remembered being told things like it.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I keep thinking I should be able to look at a page.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I don't want to show you yet.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “It has more character than the intact ones.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I keep asking myself why I remember one part so clearly and not the thing next to it.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I don't want you to agree with me just to make it easier.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “You sound like you've been waiting to tell me that.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I found something. I’m not ready to show it.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “What do you want it to do?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Now no one can see the work at all.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I don't know how to make it a short answer.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I don't know if I want the long one either.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “What if I tell you something and then have to say I don't remember the part you're going to ask about?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I don't have a whole story to tell you tonight.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “It wasn't just the bird. He wanted it to feel like a place.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Sometimes I feel like I'm being dishonest if I talk about a good day.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I don't know what I want to talk about.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I thought I was remembering the film. Then I was back there.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “And that you don't look disappointed when I don't know.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I worry I'm telling the same story too often.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I don't need you to do anything.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “You would hate how everyone gets sensible when I say your name.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I’m asking about your assessment programme. Two people I know came here.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “This says they can leave. Where does it say what happens when they try?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Sorry. I need the reference. That’s all I’m asking you for.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I understood what you were trying to do here.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Then I wasn't sure why it changed.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “That isn't all on the page yet,”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Then you don't get to ask me to hear something different when you say it.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “And you would let me lead it?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “That's a lot to put in front of someone with this history.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Do you want me to make you feel forgiven?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “What would you want me to do?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “You don't have to say the right thing.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “And if I make a choice you don't like?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I thought I asked what you think.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I'd like one answer that covers all three.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “That doesn't tell me what to choose.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “What if I keep changing my mind?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “You think I'm doing this for the wrong reason.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “If I leave it alone, it still exists.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “If I take it on, it becomes something I have to keep answering for.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “And if I don't have it tonight?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “The parts about leaving. The parts about who doesn't get recruited. They don't become things we say because I'm in the room.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I want the records kept. I want to be able to see when something isn't working.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I believe what these records establish about the current organisation.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “That doesn't make me want a place in it.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I don't want to be asked again because someone decides I need more time.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “And I am not telling you how to feel about that.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I understand the distinction you're asking me to make,”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I am not saying the original clan is still here.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “But I've decided to dismantle this organisation.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “That I'm going alone. That I don't know how long it'll take.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I don't need you to make it easier to leave.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Don't make me explain everything when I come back.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “They asked to leave. You collected one from his home. Don’t call that a channel.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “You put them in restraints. You tested weapons on them. Say what you did.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “And you always found someone you thought couldn’t hit back.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “He made things. He wanted to finish a film. You made every room smaller for him and then acted like it was nothing. I can’t get him back. I know that. But you don’t get to keep doing this.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I’m asking you to answer for what you chose. The bullying. The people locked downstairs. Your signature is right there.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Is that what Emily would be to you? An advantage to take apart?”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “And it’s the last thing about her you’re getting from me.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I don't know what to say about it.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I thought I'd be better at coming back.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “You can tell me if you just want company,”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “These are better than your first one.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “I'm trying not to be too quick at the end.”

lines.speaker: rei
lines.subtitle: “Ask me again when you've agreed what it is.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “We can keep out of the way,”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “It's why we're asking about the contact route as well as the collector.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You don't have to like us. You don't even have to think this'll work.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Checking the exit isn't a nervous habit.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “First time we met, I thought you'd last a week.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Neither of us is getting everything he wants.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Footsteps. Then nothing. Close enough that I would check before taking anyone out.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You could have said you were moving someone.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “It was less painful than ignoring it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You planning to stand there until I calm down?”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “We know the point they use. Waiting has a cost.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “If stopping him means he doesn't get up again, I can live with that.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I'm here because it might stop the next demand. Don't mistake that for faith in your book.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “That's not an apology for checking. It's why I'm checking twice.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You don't have to keep somebody interested for our benefit.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “If he reaches for them, I'm ending it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “He'll be somebody's cousin. Somebody will tell us he wasn't always like that.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Don't give them your cheerful voice next time.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “The one that says you can go home afterward.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You've separated the sound from the person.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “So you can put the useful part in,”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You missed the blind bend in your route check.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “At another hour, your clear approach isn't clear.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You can say it was the wrong one.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “That's how it grows. Everyone does one small job and goes home clean.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “We have the number and the seal now,”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Then don't make the paper wait for another paper to approve it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Before somebody tells you I imagined the seal?”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I'm listening. You can leave the sleeve alone.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “We called it the Organisation. Mercenaries. Kaden Mourne led us. I served with him, with Sylvanis, with the man who became the Crow.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I'm not. I'm telling you why I won't leave them alone.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You don't have to make yourself sound cleverer than you were. Just tell us.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “It'd be easier if places like this looked like what people say happens inside.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I meant easier to live beside without wondering what you've missed.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Don't start looking grateful. I can count.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You asked me to watch the route,”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Then you asked me to let it go.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Then say that. Don't tell me it stopped mattering.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Don't argue with the version where I didn't.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Tell me what you need, not that the thing I was doing never mattered.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Don't let the neat arrangement fool you. Somebody chose to build it this way.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I used to take orders written like this.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Under a man who bothered to ask who needed protecting. The rest of us liked having someone else ask.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “A person, a position, or somebody's right to hurt people. Yes. Let's find out which one he chose.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You intend to keep us from it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Then we've reached the part that needs less talking.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Means you picked what gets through and what doesn't. I've done it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Knew a commander who used people like us to get the wounded out. You could choose a better doorway.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “No misunderstanding to clear up. No little detail that makes him step aside.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Don't take this as me agreeing to be harmless.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I'm asking when the name entered it,”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Not telling you that you made everything up.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “If I start sounding like I rehearsed something, stop me.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “The instruction reached the people who carried it out,”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You gave plenty of instructions. We're here about those.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “He wanted me to prove I wasn't what he called me.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “And I almost wasted the whole conversation doing it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “He wanted us angry enough to do his explaining for him.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “That doesn't make it the payment we're asking about,”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You can make almost anything look clean if you stop writing down the people.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Keep it when you run out of objections.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I'm not waiting. Anybody, if that is what it takes. Me included.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You going to revise it by staring?”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Then don't wait until I'm already moving.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I was showing you where it appears.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I can tell you what touched it. Sometimes where. Not why.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Don't ask for a real name just because we're close to a face.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “No. Saves time if I ask once.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Wasn't planning to give you the easy half.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “For a while I didn't have a clean picture,”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I'm used to having something better than that to give you.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Then we look at the next one as its own problem,”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Now we can ask what connects them.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I know what it's like to have people think one name explains you.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “And because once a name gets loose, you don't get to choose who hunts it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Then we stop calling this a name.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Kaden thought knowing his people meant he could trust what they'd do next.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I think I should have. Much easier to demand that from a dead man.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “There was a corridor. I keep coming back to that. You'd think I'd remember something grander.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I want to keep the supported approach in view,”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “He used to make the rest of us wait while he finished a sentence.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You put yourself in that second sentence.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I used to imagine finding him alone.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Without anybody I had to bring home.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Do you think we can hold him?”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Whether we've started treating getting this far as an argument for going the rest of the way.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “And we say what happens if it isn't.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Say the part about taking him alive while you're looking at me.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I won't promise to spare him if killing him is the only way to stop something worse.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “If that approach changes, we acknowledge before separating.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “If I tell you to move, listen before you argue.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You're going to put down that I left the position.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Don't make it sound as though you ordered the move.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “And I won't say there was nothing wrong with the approach.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You could leave my part out. Make yourself look less like you let a vigilante argue with you.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Kaden Mourne. You remember him, or did the title make that inconvenient?”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I carried more than his name out of that place. You don't get to make him small because you survived him.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “No. I know what killing you would mean. Don't confuse Gordon being here with me forgetting.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Present. Don't make a ceremony of it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You keep stopping at the same place.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Then why does it take so long to get there?”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Don't ask me to write it for you.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Do you? Because you can put your name on every mistake in the room and still avoid talking to me about it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I wanted him to be the last one,”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I knew better than to say it like that. Still wanted it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I'm telling you what I wanted. Not asking you to explain the case.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “It doesn't make them an argument for it, either.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You keep stopping at the same place.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Then why does it take so long to get there?”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Don't ask me to write it for you.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Do you? Because you can put your name on every mistake in the room and still avoid talking to me about it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I wanted him to be the last one,”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I knew better than to say it like that. Still wanted it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I'm telling you what I wanted. Not asking you to explain the case.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “It doesn't make them an argument for it, either.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Not contain. Not make him answer a question. I wanted him dead, and I wanted you there because you might help me do it. You need to hear that part too.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “If it stopped enough of what he does. Yes.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Then I'd have to live with being wrong.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Don't put your name on my choices.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “And the routing label doesn't become his name because we want something else from the files.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Depends how much you wanted to be interviewed.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You've had plenty of time to understand it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You can say that without making me feel you've postponed an appointment.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “That explains the poor use of your time.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Sometimes. Mostly to tell him he was wrong. Doesn't make for much of a conversation.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Something I'd hate. Then he'd check whether I'd eaten.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I don't want to become him. That's the bit people get wrong. I want him back, and I know I can't have that. So I keep finding other things I can do with my hands.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Sit there, then. Don't ask me to make it a good hour.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “If a local job doesn't tell us anything new about him, we still do it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “If a day comes when I have to choose between your rules and stopping something worse, you know which I'll choose.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Then we go back to the first protected contact.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I won't pretend this gives Kaden anything back.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You're asking me to trust a door again.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Then keep your people honest. I'll keep looking at the hinges.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “We aren't asking you to stand here and prove somebody will come.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Thought I'd ask before becoming a lesson in the next report.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “What did they ask you to do?”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I know. No charging the whole city for the last man's debt.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You'll want me back in one piece.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Don't look so pleased. I didn't say you've won the argument.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You ask that before you ask what we lost.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “They'll need us again. We leave, somebody else moves in.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Put me on the next road detail. I'll clear it faster.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Every day. Doesn't mean I think he was right about everything.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Keep going. Don't wait for me to say it twice.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “That's what everyone says when they want the first thing to make the second easier.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You'd tell me to get some sleep.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You thought there was a line they wouldn't cross if you kept showing them where it was.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I won't ask them to be better. I'll stop them.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Don't turn a spare cup into an assessment.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Someone signs these and never sees where the cargo ends up.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Protection. Everyone likes that word when they're the one deciding who gets it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Used to be proud of how little explaining I needed.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I meant I obeyed quickly. Don't improve the admission.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Meals, breaks, rehearsals. Plenty of time to remember you're a person before telling someone else what to do to one.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Someone decided this was worth paying for.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “You think the people at the top ever lose sleep over a figure?”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Very hard to have a satisfying prejudice around you.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “Give somebody a trace and they'll build you a person.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “I can compare it. Following comes after we know what could have carried it.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “That's all you've got? No clever question about what my senses really tell me?”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: “He built all this out of a place that used to take people in.”

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: A clear route on paper is still worth checking from the doorway.

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: We keep the record to what we can establish.

lines.speaker: fox
lines.subtitle: Guard posts first. Then the operation target. Stay ready.
